claims.statement: The universal affine/singular half-Riesz assertion for all symmetric S with s2(S)>=1 has exactly the same best constant as the homogeneous assertion restricted to invertible S with s2(S)=1 and zero affine term.

Two independent aggregate square channels on disjoint product banks have a uniform half-Riesz bound 128 sqrt(M_Y M_Z)|alpha beta|^{-1/4}; for equal signs this improves to 2 sqrt(2 pi) sqrt(M_Y M_Z)|alpha beta|^{-1/4}.
For S_m=direct_sum_{r=1}^m J_m/m, the half-Riesz potential is at most 2 sqrt(2 pi e)<8.266 for arbitrary cap-one product inputs, despite maximum physical principal-pair determinant 1/m^2.
There is a universal C_H such that every invertible symmetric S with s2(S)=1 and every cap-one product vector Z satisfy sup_t E|Z^T S Z-t|^{-1/2}<=C_H.
